source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: لما كنت صغير، كنت أسكن ببيت جدي.
sentences.en: When I was little, I used to live in my grandfather's house.

sentences.ar: كان البيت قديم وفيه حديقة كبيرة.
sentences.en: The house was old and had a big garden.

sentences.ar: كل الصبح، كنت أصحى على صوت العصافير.
sentences.en: Every morning, I would wake up to the sound of birds.

sentences.ar: جدي كان يعلمني كيف أزرع وأسقي الشجر.
sentences.en: My grandfather used to teach me how to plant and water the trees.

sentences.ar: بعد الظهر، كنت ألعب مع ولاد الحارة.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, I would play with the neighborhood kids.

sentences.ar: كنا نلعب لآخر النهار ونرجع تعبانين.
sentences.en: We would play until the end of the day and come back tired.

sentences.ar: بالليل، جدتي كانت تطبخ أكل بيتهني.
sentences.en: At night, my grandmother would cook delicious food.

sentences.ar: كانت أيام بسيطة بس حلوة كتير.
sentences.en: They were simple days but very lovely.
To this day, I remember them and miss them.
